_comment: Vector: upload the release ZIP before first start. Node.js is required.
name: Vector — Node.js
author: noreply@vector.example.com
description: Vector geospatial intelligence. Upload/extract the release at /home/container; optional provider keys go in private configuration.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Upload and extract the Vector release ZIP into the server root before starting."

variables.name: Bind address
variables.description: Bind to all interfaces inside the container.

variables.name: Public origin
variables.description: Canonical HTTPS origin, such as https://vector.example.com.

variables.name: Trusted proxy
variables.description: Exact Nginx source IP/subnet; Docker bridge proxies may need their gateway IP. Never trust all addresses.
